reviews.author: Khalil B…
reviews.body:
Kel did an absolutely amazing job with my son. My son was crying, moving around, and having a hard time sitting still, but Kel never once got frustrated or made us feel rushed. He stayed calm, patient, and understanding throughout the entire haircut.

What really stood out to me was his professionalism and attention to detail. Even with the challenges, he took his time and made sure my son’s haircut came out great. He handled the situation with so much care and compassion, and it was clear that he genuinely wanted my son to have a positive experience.

I’ve been to a lot of barbers over the years, and I can honestly say I’ve never seen this level of patience and professionalism. Kel has definitely earned a lifelong customer. If you’re looking for a barber who’s skilled, respectful, and incredible with kids, I highly recommend him.
